title: Senior Backend Java Developer
description: Migros’ta İyi Geleceği Birlikte Tasarlayalım! 🧡 Hayat bir alışveriş bizim için, mutluluk alıp, mutluluk verdiğimiz... Raflarımız ödül ve başarılarla dolu… 20 yıldır “Türkiye’nin En Beğenilen Perakende Şirketi” seçilmek, Türkiye’nin ilk sadakat programını yaratmak, Türk perakende müşterisini kasiyersiz kasa ile tanıştırmak, Perakende sektöründe ilk AR-GE merkezini kurmak başarılarımızdan sadece birkaç tanesidir. Migroslular olarak biz, Perakendenin geçmişine ve geleceğine çok meraklıyız! Türkiye’de modern perakende sektörünün öncüsü olarak, 1954’ten bu yana bizim işimiz, iyi geleceği tasarlamaktır! Her Migroslu’nun kendi kariyer hikayesini yaratmasına fırsat sağladığımız “İyi Gelecek Yolculuğumuzun” bir parçası olmak isterseniz, başvurunuzu bekliyoruz! Migros’ta Bizler; 😊 Yaptığımız her işte mutluluk yaratırız. 🤝 Kendimize güvenir, Karşımızdakine güven verir ve güven duyarız. 🌿👫 Hassas noktamız doğa ve insandır. 🌟 İyi geleceğe öncülük ederiz. 🏆 Potansiyeli aşarız büyük başarılar yaşarız. 🚀 İyi fikirler geliştirir "yok artık" denilen fikirlere "var artık" deriz. Sizde Aradığımız Özellikler Neler? Tercihen üniversitelerin Mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun, Java programlama dili ile en az 5 yıl profesyonel deneyime sahip, Spring/Spring Boot frameworkleri ile uygulama geliştirme tecrübesine sahip, NoSQL veri tabanları (ElasticSearch, MongoDB vb.) konusunda deneyimli, İlişkisel veri tabanları (MySQL, PostgreSQL vb.) kullanımı konusunda bilgi sahibi, Dağıtık mesajlaşma sistemleri (Kafka, RabbitMQ vb.) konusunda deneyimli, Cache yapıları (Redis, Memcached vb.) konusunda deneyimli, Docker ve Kubernetes gibi container ve orchestration araçlarını kullanabilen, Microservice mimarisi ve event sourcing konularında bilgi sahibi, Yeni teknolojileri takip eden ve geliştirme ortamına entegre edebilen, Agile/Scrum metodolojileri hakkında bilgi sahibi. Aramıza Katıldığınızda Neler Yapacaksınız? Bilgi Teknolojileri ve İş Geliştirme Direktörlüğü‘ne bağlı “Migros Next” ekibimizde, Dönüşüm sürecinde yeniden tasarlanacak sistemlerin mimari tasarımlarında görev almak, Karşılaşılan farklı problemlere ekip ile birlikte çözüm üretmek, Backend tarafındaki web servislerinin geliştirilmesinden sorumlu olmak, Backend uygulamalarının tasarım, geliştirme ve bakım süreçlerini yürütmek. Yetenek Kazanımı Sürecimiz Nasıl İlerleyecek? Özgeçmiş ön değerlendirme süreci İnsan Kaynakları Görüşmesi Değerlendirme Testleri Birim Görüşmesi Referans Araştırması Teklif Süreci 🤞🏻 *Görüşülen pozisyonun niteliğine göre süreç adımlarında değişiklik gerçekleşebilir. 📲Sosyal Medya kanallarında iş fırsatlarımızı takip etmeye devam edebilirsiniz. #Migros #İyiİşİyiGelecek *Sürdürülebilir büyüme, eşit imkanlar ve farklı bakış açılarıyla mümkündür. Lead Network Europe (NPO)’nun Gold Partneri olarak; İnsan Hakları ve Fırsat Eşitliği politikamız doğrultusunda, Migros’ta herkesin şeffaf, adil ve eşit haklara sahip olması gerektiğine inanıyor ve çalışıyoruz.

title: Java Backend Developer (E-Commerce)
description: ABOUT US BİM Birleşik Mağazalar A.Ş., which began operations in 1995 with 21 stores, is today the company with the highest market share in Turkey's organized retail sector. BİM's core principle is delivering essential food and consumer goods to customers at the highest quality and most competitive prices. As the first representative of the hard-discount model in Turkey, BİM offers a product range of approximately 900 items — the majority of which are its own private-label brands — through its retail stores operating across the country. In addition, BİM launched an online shopping service for non-food products via the BİM MARKET mobile application in late 2021. BİM continued its steady growth in 2024, opening 886 new domestic stores throughout the year to reach a total of 12,089 stores in Turkey by year-end. The company continues to develop while maintaining its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction alongside an effective cost management policy. About the Role We're looking for a Java Backend Developer to join our e-commerce platform team. You'll develop and own backend services end-to-end, collaborate closely with product and engineering, and help build a scalable, reliable system using modern tools and AI-assisted development practices. Responsibilities Contribute to architectural design and develop in line with established technical standards Effectively use AI-assisted coding tools as part of daily development workflows Develop backend services and features end-to-end and own them in production Build inter-service communication and data flows aligned with the existing architecture Develop solutions with scalability and performance targets in mind Apply security and observability practices throughout development Work closely with product and other teams to turn requirements into technical solutions Actively participate in code reviews, upholding quality and maintainability standards Analyze challenging technical problems and produce effective solutions Document development work and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team Qualifications 3–8 years of backend development experience Experience with Java and the Spring Boot / Spring Cloud ecosystem Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as part of daily development workflows Experience developing in a microservices architecture (API design, inter-service communication, data modeling) Experience building event-driven systems with Kafka or similar messaging platforms Experience with query optimization and migration management on PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases) Experience with caching using Redis Experience with container-based deployment using Docker and Kubernetes Strong command of code quality, maintainability, test automation, CI/CD, and observability (logging, metrics, tracing) Experience with AWS services (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, MSK, S3) Experience working on high-traffic systems (e-commerce, payments, banking, telecom, etc.) Experience with Elasticsearch / OpenSearch for search and filtering

title: Sr. Backend Engineer
description: Apilex is an AI-native legal operating system that manages lawyers' entire legal workflows end to end, powered by AI systems purpose-built for each jurisdiction's legal framework. We bring legal research, drafting of pleadings and contracts, document analysis, and case preparation together in a single experience. We currently operate in France, Turkey, and Germany, and we aim to extend the growth we've achieved in our current markets to Brazil, Spain, and Italy. We achieved this growth entirely bootstrapped, without raising any external investment, making us one of the fastest go-to-market success stories among Legal AI startups in the world. Since our founding, we've scaled our team to 120+ people, backed by a proprietary database of millions of court decisions and legal documents that turns days of legal research into seconds. What sets us apart? We don't use off-the-shelf AI. We build domain-specific, closed-circuit AI models with multi-layered verification systems that eliminate hallucinations and deliver answers backed by real citations and legal reasoning. Every feature we ship changes how lawyers work. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and scale the high-traffic microservices that form the backbone of our global legal AI platform. Key Responsibilities Scalable Architecture: Design and develop high-traffic, scalable microservice architectures to support our expanding global footprint. Code Excellence: Raise the bar on code quality by leading code review processes and implementing best practices across the backend. Technical Leadership: Provide mentorship to the engineering team and guide technical decision-making for complex features. System Integration: Build and maintain reliable integrations between core services, AI agents, and large-scale data stores. Performance Optimization: Ensure system reliability and low latency across distributed services through efficient caching and messaging strategies. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of backend experience building and scaling Java and Spring Boot applications in production Strong foundation in software architecture design including OOP and SOLID principles across various scales Hands-on experience with both PostgreSQL and MongoDB including the ability to design hybrid data architectures Deep knowledge of Elasticsearch or similar technologies for high-performance search and indexing Practical experience with messaging systems like RabbitMQ or Kafka and in-memory caching with Redis Solid understanding of WebSocket and real-time streaming architectures for distributed environments Direct experience with cloud platforms and building automated CI/CD pipelines Ability to ship high-quality code and iterate quickly rather than waiting for perfect conditions Why join us? Whatever your role, your work here will be visible and meaningful. We're a team that has grown without outside investment and achieved one of the fastest go-to-market successes in the space and we're looking for ambitious people who want to build the future of legal technology on a global stage. This is Apilex. AI for Legal. Join us.
